responsibility: C++-specific genericization and gimplification support between front-end trees and generic/GIMPLE form. It rewrites C++ statement and expression nodes such as TRY_BLOCK, HANDLER, IF_STMT, EH_SPEC_BLOCK, constexpr/consteval conditionals, and various builtins into generic representations the middle end understands, and also performs C++-specific folding helpers such as __builtin_source_location materialization and OpenMP/language hook callbacks during lowering.
